scripts.build:package: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../../Cargo.toml -p actr-cli -- pkg pack --manifest-path manifest.toml --payload-root . --key ../../../../examples/actr/rust/package-echo/dev-key.json --output dist/actrium-counter-1.0.0.actr
scripts.build:actr: bun run build && bun run build:package
scripts.verify:package: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../../Cargo.toml -p actr-cli -- pkg verify --package dist/actrium-counter-1.0.0.actr --pubkey ../../../../examples/actr/rust/package-echo/dev-key.json
